title: Student Murders Professor After Being Expelled
description:
When cops arrested Murad Dervish for murder last year, he allegedly voiced hope that the victim, University of Arizona Professor Thomas Meixner, was "okay”. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.

Law&Crime BodyCam takes you on patrol and in the line of duty with raw footage of police encounters. Grounded in expert narration and insightful commentary from a trusted journalist and attorney, each episode of BodyCam features high-stakes situations with expert analysis.
